alerts.title: TDF and Kidney Function
alerts.message: Guidelines suggest monitoring kidney function for patients on TDF. Patient has a creatinine level of 112 umol/L, which is within normal limits. However, it is essential to continue monitoring kidney function, especially with the patient's history of occasionally missing amlodipine doses, which may affect blood pressure and, in turn, kidney function. Non-drug causes such as dehydration should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Continue monitoring serum creatinine and eGFR
